title: Ade almost paid a scholarship scammer
caption: Ade almost paid $300 to "secure" a scholarship 😬 Real scholarships NEVER ask you to pay to win them. Share this with a friend who's applying 🙏 #scholarship #scamalert #studyabroad #storytime

scenes.backdrop: busy African city street at night with colorful shop lights and wet road

beats.text: Quddus! I won a scholarship to Canada! Full funding, flight, everything!
beats.say: Kuddus! I won a scholarship to Canada! Full funding, flight, everything!
They didn't say yet. But the agent said I just need to pay three hundred dollars to secure my slot.
Ade. Put the phone down. Slowly.
Why? He sounded very nice. He even used five emojis.

scenes.backdrop: cozy African living room with a sofa, plants and evening light through the window

beats.say: Listen. Real scholarships never ask you to pay money to win them or to secure a slot.

card.title: SCAM RED FLAGS
lines: 1f4b8|Pay a fee to secure your scholarship
23f0|You won something you never applied for
1f4f1|Only talks on WhatsApp, no official email

beats.say: But how do I know which ones are real?
Check the official website. A real university or government scholarship has its own page, and you apply there, not through a random agent.

card.title: HOW TO CHECK
lines: 1f50e|Search the name plus the word scam

beats.say: So the scholarship that found me on WhatsApp at midnight was not real.
Exactly. Opportunities don't chase you in your DMs. You apply for them.
Okay. I'm blocking him. Then I'm reporting him.
Good. And next time, send me the link before you send anyone money.
Deal! My three hundred dollars says thank you.

scenes.backdrop: night city skyline with soft bokeh lights, purple and teal glow, cinematic

beats.text: Comment SAFE if you've seen a scam like this, and share this with a friend who's applying.
